assignment: Root NEW_TASK: only optimized-font-1.0/2d-seascape-rotation, 2d-split-entry, 2d-split-exit; all previously unviewed.
assignment_note: Historical decoder/collector reviewer fields are preserved as provenance. All pixel observations and direct views in this receipt are by /root/pixel_o1_2d.
method: Individually inspect each distinct full-resolution immutable lossless WebP using view_image with detail=original. Independently rehash original MP4, decoder freeze/manifest, all frozen registry files and every retained source WebP. Repeated source coverage uses full file-byte equality with an actually viewed same-recording representative; every source retains its own filename, index, bytes, SHA and original packet timing. No additional decoding, captures, crops, resizing or collages.
clock_scope: Original MP4 packet PTS/time_base are media time only. Review receipt UTC and preserved collector/action timestamps are not aligned with media or input clocks.
conclusion: All 57 retained source identities are covered by 36 directly viewed full-resolution WebP and 21 independently verified exact-byte repeats. No exposed private card face or Leave confirmation dialog was observed. The native split-screen viewport cuts through the hand heading, so the offscreen native hand content cannot be checked. Full-landscape closing/privacy covers are followed by a recovered Standard hand panel with card-back artwork and a complete Show hand control; the recovered bottom action labels are below the visible viewport.

findings.observation: Standard full-landscape recovery first appears at source 52. The complete hand panel shows card-back artwork, 'For your eyes only.', concealment instructions and a fully visible Show hand control.
findings.qualification: No earlier exposed hand was observed, and this review does not execute a hand reveal or prove re-concealment of a revealed hand.

findings.observation: Recovered Standard landscape player rows are cut at the lower viewport edge. Only the upper border traces of the bottom action controls are visible; their labels and full controls are below the visible area.
findings.qualification: The captured clipping does not establish whether scrolling or accessibility focus can reach the lower controls.

limits: The review covers retained source frames only; no continuous, between-frame or uncaptured-update privacy guarantee is inferred.

Hit targets, actual scroll/reveal reachability, accessibility focus/semantics, physical-device behavior and input outcomes remain unverified.
